name: Stormy Ocean
desc: A dark heaving sea under a bruised squall sky — layered swell crests, blown spray, and partial-frame lightning that flares on treble spikes.

energy.doc: storm intensity — swell height, spray volume, foam & flash amplitude

density.doc: detail — number of swell bands (3..8), cloud & spray count

hue.doc: primary sea/sky hue (210 cold marine blue)

scale.doc: wave amplitude + wavelength vs design size

x.doc: wind direction bias (0 left, 1 right) — sets scroll sign

style.doc: rendering discipline — marine tonal wash, sumi ink, schematic contour wireframe, thermal false-color, riso 2-ink misregistration

act.doc: multi-minute dramaturgy — building squall, long rolling swell, or calm-to-building doldrums
